summary: Kings or surrounding peoples bring a gift to God. Isaiah names Mount Zion as the place to which the gift is carried.

senses.definition: The giver brings a present to a ruler or to Yahweh at his sanctuary. In all three passages the verb יבל describes bringing it.

note: The attested noun has two consonants. The dictionary places it beside שטר in its index, but the word contains neither ט nor ר. Later Hebrew also uses the word for tribute.
